If your digital marketing skills were built for a world before AI, you’re not alone. Most people working in, or moving into, marketing are figuring it out as they go.
This course changes that.
The Digital Marketing with AI Bootcamp is a 13-week, part-time programme that gives you a structured, practical foundation in digital marketing — with AI woven into every part of it. You’ll cover the full range of digital marketing disciplines and learn how to use AI tools to work more effectively. Not as a shortcut, but as a genuine skill.
This could be for you if you are:
A Career Changer - You want to move into digital marketing and know AI is already reshaping how it's done but you're not sure where to start or whether the skills you build now will actually be relevant.
The Inhouse Marketer - You're already doing marketing but AI is moving faster than you can keep up with, and you're not confident you're using it in the right way.
A multi-hat professional - Marketing is one part of your role, not all of it — and you're doing it without formal training or a clear framework behind you.

The course is open to all applicants.
